content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

Gumroad positions itself as an easy-to-use platform for selling digital products, but it comes with a 10% fee on every sale. NOWPayments, in contrast, offers a more cost-effective solution with only a 0.5% fee. This significant difference means that for creators selling digital products priced at $97, the choice of infrastructure can lead to a major difference in revenue. With NOWPayments, a creator retains more of their earnings, allowing for greater investment back into their business. Additionally, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing flexibility in payment options that traditional platforms often lack.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and similar platforms typically impose geographic restrictions that limit access for many creators in Africa and South America. In contrast, NOWPayments is designed to function globally without such restrictions, making it an ideal choice for those in regions where traditional platforms have failed. This unrestricted access allows creators to tap into the global market without the constant worry of payment processing issues. The architecture provided by COREMERCH ensures that even in areas facing currency instability or financial isolation, creators can reliably sell their digital products and receive payments.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When considering payment processing, speed and fees are crucial factors. Gumroad's 10% fee can add up quickly; for instance, with 100 sales of a $97 product, creators would pay $970 in fees. Conversely, with NOWPayments charging only 0.5%, the fee would total just $48.50. This results in a staggering difference of approximately $921 retained by the creator. Moreover, NOWPayments provides instant verification of transactions, ensuring that creators receive payment as soon as the sale is made, further enhancing cash flow compared to the potential delays with traditional platforms.
Ownership of your digital products means no ongoing fees or subscriptions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant advantages of using NOWPayments with a COREMERCH stack is ownership. Unlike Gumroad, where the platform retains control over your listings, with COREMERCH’s system, creators own their entire commerce stack. This means there are no ongoing subscriptions, and you have complete control over your products and customer data. Additionally, automated delivery through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script ensures that customers receive their purchases immediately after payment confirmation, streamlining the process and improving customer satisfaction.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For digital creators focused on maximizing revenue and minimizing fees, adopting a system built around NOWPayments and COREMERCH is the most viable architecture. If you are dealing with restricted access in your region or expect to grow your sales volume, investing in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) will provide you with everything needed to set up a sovereign digital commerce stack. This path not only enhances your operational independence but also positions you for sustainable growth without the constraints imposed by traditional platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
A 0.5% fee with NOWPayments keeps more profit in your pocket.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
